items.exposure_expanded:antialias_filter.toolt: Makes the image soft and slightly blurry.
Might not be noticeable in most photos.
items.exposure_expanded:art_filter.tooltip: Makes pixels large, circular and blurry.
items.exposure_expanded:bits_filter.tooltip: Gives the image a retro effect.
items.exposure_expanded:blobs_2_filter.tooltip: Makes pixels large, circular and blurry.
items.exposure_expanded:c64_film.tooltip: Vanity film with the 16 colors a Commodore 64 can display.
items.exposure_expanded:cga_film.tooltip: Vanity film with the 4 colors of CGA Palette 1 (High Intensity).
Increases the perceived saturation of the image.
items.exposure_expanded:deconverge_filter.tool: Gives the image a chromatic aberration effect.
items.exposure_expanded:desaturate_filter.tool: Desaturates the image, but not fully.
items.exposure_expanded:flip_filter.tooltip: Flips the image upside down vertically.
items.exposure_expanded:gameboy_film.tooltip: Vanity film with colors resembling the monochrome Gameboy palette.
items.exposure_expanded:hicap_hisen_black_and_: High-Capacity High-Sensitivity Black and White Film
items.exposure_expanded:hires_hisen_black_and_: High-Resolution High-Sensitivity Black and White Film
items.exposure_expanded:instant_hires_black_an: Instant High-Resolution Black and White Slide
items.exposure_expanded:nes_film.tooltip: Vanity film with all 54 colors an NES can display.
items.exposure_expanded:ntsc_filter.tooltip: Adds a strong blur and scanlines.
items.exposure_expanded:panoramic_lens.tooltip: Very wide, for shots with multiple subjects.
items.exposure_expanded:pencil_filter.tooltip1: Makes the image look like a pencil drawing.
items.exposure_expanded:phosphor_filter.toolti: Adds motion blur. Use while moving.
items.exposure_expanded:spider_filter.tooltip: Makes the image look like the sight of a spider.
items.exposure_expanded:telescopic_lens.toolti: Just a little bit higher zoom for long range shots.
items.exposure_expanded:wobble_filter.tooltip1: Adds wobbles and randomly cycles the hue.
items.exposure_expanded:wobble_filter.tooltip2: The hue will be static in the final image.
